title: [EPIC] Gaja photo mode — Pixelfed replacement
description: Add Instagram-style photo sharing as a fieldwork capability available to ALL three servers (broadside, smallhold, gaja). Photo processing, albums, filters, and Pixelfed API compatibility live in fieldwork/fieldwork-db. Each server wires the routes appropriate to its personality. Broadside: photo galleries for org announcements. Smallhold: personal Instagram. Gaja: multi-tenant photo platform.
